limitations: Only five development cases and the Integrated T07 evidence task were reviewed; Single answers did not retrieve evidence and do not supply a comparable support denominator.
The support labels are a non-independent engineering assessment of retrieved chunk text, not physician review, clinical validation, or a claim that the statements themselves are clinically correct.
No controlled RAG-versus-no-RAG answer-accuracy comparison was run; no causal improvement claim is supported.
The review scores answer-specific source-to-claim links, not all medical claims across all 40 tasks or all 823,450 indexed chunks.
